messages:
Mike J: Noticed a steady memory plateau then sudden KV-cache jump during long streaming on H100 and MI250. Sequence ramp 64->8192 over ~1.2M tokens.
Sara L: Can you paste the exact run command and the minimal repro config?
Mike J: Repro command: `./bench_paged_attn --model=llama2-13b --seq-ramp=64,8192 --total-tokens=1200000 --prefetch-window=8 --kerns=auto --batch 1`
Mike J: Tail of runtime log:
```
[2025-11-03T03:21:14Z] kvcache: page_alloc idx=5421 owner=0x7f8a3e state=COLD
[2025-11-03T03:21:14Z] pagetable: flatmap_grow old_slots=8192 new_slots=65536
[2025-11-03T03:21:14Z] kvcache: evict_scan hit=0 scanned=12345 threshold=1024
[2025-11-03T03:21:15Z] ERROR pagetable: remap_race owner_mismatch expected=0x7f8a3e got=0x0
```
Raj P: owner_mismatch -> stale-owner/zeroed-owner. We've seen similar but usually single-GPU. This one reproduces on both H100 and MI250.
Alyssa M: Did kernel selection flip at that point? auto can switch to tiled kernels which prefetch aggressively and blow up the reuse window.
Mike J: Yes, kernel log: `kerns=auto -> selected=tiled_prefetch_v2` right before the spike.
Ops: Perf counters show page-faults and PCIe stall latency spiking at the same token boundary. MI250 shows longer stall tail so eviction loop lingers.
Sara L: Sounds like two interactions: prefetch enlarges working set; pagetable/flatmap expansion has a race during concurrent evict+alloc. If an evict clears owner between allocate and publish, you get a remap race.
Raj P: I instrumented flatmap_grow: we do allocate_new_slabs(); init_slots(); publish_root(new_root); If an evict clears an entry after init_slots but before publish_root, subsequent remap assumes owner present but owner==0.
Alyssa M: Earlier fix for shadow-map used cmpxchg to swap roots and tombstones during evict. We can apply similar atomics here.
Mike J: Quick patch: add slot_epoch + set tombstone flag in evict instead of zeroing owner. Repro still triggers but messages change to `stale_epoch` instead of `owner_mismatch`. Better diagnostics but not a full fix.
Raj P: Profiling shows evict_scan dominates runtime during the ramp; with many holes the scan repeats same ranges. The algorithm is currently full-scan O(N).
Alyssa M: Mitigation list:
- reduce default prefetch_window for long-ramp workloads
- make eviction scanning incremental with a persistent cursor so we avoid rescanning hot ranges
- enforce atomic publish for flatmap_grow (cmpxchg root) and tombstone semantics for evict
- throttle kernel heuristics to avoid switching into aggressive prefetch under sustained seq growth
Mike J: Short-term toggle suggestion: `--kvcache-evict-iter=1` to limit scan per allocation; set as Dedicated infra default. Medium-term: atomic publish + tombstone + incremental evict cursor.
Ops: Add a CI nightly that runs a 200k token ramp on both H100 and MI250 with `--kerns=auto --prefetch-window=8` and assert no `remap_race` logs. Job can live in infra/nightly-repro.
Sara L: Also normalize slab sizing: MI250 allocator picks smaller slab sizes causing more meta entries and bigger flatmap expansion factor. We should harmonize slab granularities across archs.
Raj P: Added telemetry points needed: flatmap_alloc_count, tombstone_count, evict_cursor_pos, last_flatmap_slots. Will hook into kvcache perf metric set.
Mike J: I'll run the repro pinned to Dedicated H100 and MI250 overnight and drop logs here. Job created: `ci-bot: nightly-repro scheduled id=kv-ramp-12087`
ci-bot: Job kv-ramp-12087 queued on dedicated/nv-h100-1 and dedicated/amd-mi250-3.
Alyssa M: Assigning to Raj and Sara for the initial CL draft. I'll coordinate kernel heuristics changes with eng-ml after the core remap fix. :thumbsup:
